verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events. Vonage Video API offers event webhooks (session, stream and archive callbacks) and a fixed automatic-archiving session setting. Webhooks are developer building blocks: the developer's own server would have to implement any trigger-action logic. Auto-archive is a single preset behavior, not a configurable rule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
